name: Quiver sample
description: Player storage sample: an 18-slot quiver for arrows and spells (it follows the game's tombstone rule) and an 8-slot satchel for anything, both kept with your character by Kiln. /quiver lists them; /quiver store moves ammunition from your backpack into the quiver, /quiver take gives a stack back, /quiver use equips one from the quiver, /quiver activate swaps it into your backpack first, /quiver stash and /quiver unstash use the satchel. The quiver's stacks show in the HUD's ammunition and spell lists, and picking one there equips it.
